title: Wemby’s Timeout? Just Pass Him the Roof
take: Wemby is so tall the Spurs stopped calling timeouts and just pass him the roof.
style: clean sharp grade, cool arena lighting, playful mood

cast.name: Victor Wembanyama
cast.look: an extremely tall, very slim 7-foot-4 French basketball player with very long limbs, short dark hair and sharp youthful features, towering over everyone around him
cast.wardrobe: a plain solid black or silver basketball jersey with no logos, no numbers, no lettering

cast.name: a weary head coach
cast.look: a tired middle-aged basketball head coach holding a clipboard, sleeves rolled up, thousand-yard stare
cast.wardrobe: a plain grey polo shirt and dark trousers with no lettering

scenes.venue: the courtside team bench of a packed basketball arena
scenes.action: Coach NBA sits, literally looking up at Wembanyama who is standing with his head almost in the arena rafters. The other players nearby have to lean way back just to see his face.
scenes.camera: low-angle wide shot, full-figure, capturing Wembanyama towering over the entire bench squad and coach
scenes.line: Timeout? Son, just grab the roof and come back when you’re ready.
scenes.delivery: dry, clearly exasperated but almost impressed, slightly shaking his head

scenes.venue: a packed basketball arena at night, bright broadcast lighting, blurred crowd
scenes.action: Wembanyama leaps, arms fully extended, gently rips a loose ceiling tile down and studies it like a clipboard. Everyone stares, mouths open.
scenes.camera: full-figure wide shot, letting Wembanyama’s reach and the audience’s shocked reactions fill the vertical frame
scenes.line: Coach, I’m drawing up the play up here. Whole court’s my whiteboard now.
scenes.delivery: deadpan, with total sincerity, towering well above everyone in shot
